questionText:
which word fills the blank in this research-library passage?

why medications are used in _____
surrogacy medications help prepare the body for embryo transfer, support the uterine lining, and coordinate
timing with the fertility clinic.
gestational surrogacy usually involves embryo transfer.
the embryo is created through IVF.
the gestational carrier does not provide the egg.
a transfer cycle may be medicated or natural, depending on the clinic plan.
medications may help control cycle timing.
medications may help build the uterine lining.
medications may help prevent ovulation at the wrong time in some protocols.
medications may provide progesterone support after transfer.
intended parents or egg providers may use ovulation-stimulation medications during IVF.
catchRule: catch 10 starred fruits. no star? let it pass.
